artworks.title: At Sea
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts figures near a structure with poles, potentially on a ship deck. The drawing uses minimalistic and loose lines to outline the forms of a group of figures leaning towards a railing or edge. The structure may be a building or part of a ship. The lines are sparse, focusing on movement and form rather than detail, creating a sense of simplicity and fluidity in the scene.

artworks.title: Nocturnal Note
artworks.description: The image shows a series of vertical and horizontal pencil lines and smudges intersecting and blending across the surface. The vertical lines are concentrated toward the middle, and the abstract shapes extend horizontally, creating a sense of distance. On the bottom right, there is faint writing alongside a small rectangular red stamp in the lower left corner.

artworks.title: Venice
artworks.medium: black crayon on wove paper mounted to paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a body of water. The horizon is positioned at the upper third of the composition, with a faint outline of a structure or trees. The scene is depicted in a minimalistic style using horizontal pencil strokes to suggest rippling water and distant elements with a hazy quality. Several vertical forms, potentially wooden posts or stakes, are seen emerging from the water, along with a small, indistinct floating object nearby. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray against a light tan surface, creating a subdued and calm visual impact.

artworks.title: Standing Female Figure
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on the back of a printed calling card for Mrs. Henry B. Callander, 72, Cadogan Place
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of a person shown in profile from head to toe. The individual is depicted with a poised posture, wearing a hat, long dress, and having long hair. The sketch is created with simple and elegant lines, against a plain background. An abstract design is included in a smaller sketch on the right side of the image.

artworks.title: Sketch of Maud
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of the upper body of a seated person. The person is slightly turned inward, with their torso facing right. The sketch shows the person's facial features and hair lightly drawn, with the head slightly inclined downward. The hair appears to be tied back. The clothing is suggested by soft lines, indicating a garment draped around the shoulder and torso. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held. An inscription in the bottom left corner reads, "To S.P. Avery, Sunday, June 22, 1873, Whistler S.W." The background is plain, focusing on the sketch on textured paper.

artworks.title: The Two Couples in the Forest
artworks.artist: Johan Wierix after Lucas van Leyden
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals in a forest setting. The individuals are standing closely together, with two women in the foreground, a man slightly behind them to the left, and another man to the right. The women are dressed in long, flowing garments with intricate folds and wear headdresses. One woman has a serene expression and delicate features, while the other woman is looking downward. The men have longer hair and wear tunics with extended sleeves, with one gesturing. They appear to be engaged in an interaction. The background features tall trees with visible branches and foliage.

artworks.title: Abel Francois Poisson, Marquis de Marigny
artworks.artist: Johann Georg Wille after Louis Tocqué
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a distinguished pose. He displays a strong gaze, high forehead, and well-defined cheekbones. His hair is styled in a formal, powdered manner typical of the 18th century. He wears richly decorated clothing with intricate embroidery and fur trim, including a sash and lace cuffs. His right hand rests on what appears to be an architectural drawing on an ornately carved table. In the background, heavy drapery is drawn in a formal setting, possibly indicating a grand interior or stage. A curtain with tassels hangs prominently, adding to the opulent atmosphere. The overall setting exudes an air of elegance and high status.

artworks.title: Noah's Ark
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large, crowded scene with various animals and structures. The drawing depicts numerous animals such as horses, camels, birds, and an elephant in a densely packed group, appearing to move towards or board an ark-like wooden structure. The ark is detailed with rivets and some architectural features, with birds in flight and perched upon the structure. The animals are shown in dynamic poses, giving a sense of movement and urgency. The foreground is filled with animals, while in the background, more birds, architectural features, and other animals can be seen. There are a few human-like figures depicted with detailed clothing and expressions, guiding or gesturing towards the ark. This is in the style of a Renaissance artist.

artworks.title: Pharaoh and the Plague of Frogs
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a banquet scene under an archway. It includes numerous figures gathered around a circular table with ornate tableware. Above, a grand canopy is suspended. The architectural elements feature arches and pillars with intricate patterns. In the background, figures are engaged in dynamic actions, some in motion through a corridor. The scene suggests a narrative context or event.

artworks.title: Winter, the Fox Hunt
artworks.description: The image shows a snow-covered landscape from a slightly elevated angle. In the foreground, a fox is lying in the snow, facing towards the middle of the composition. In the distance, there are birds in flight against the landscape. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing the textures of the fox's fur and the snow. The color palette is monochromatic, with varying shades of gray. The background shows a blurry landscape under a dark sky.

artworks.title: Madonna
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated in a profile view turned slightly towards the viewer. The individual’s head is slightly turned, with their face in partial shadow, displaying softly sketched features and dark hair partially covered by a headscarf. The person wears a loose garment draping around their shoulders and arms, creating light and shadow play with the folds. They hold an object in their hands, delicately drawn in the foreground. The background consists of deep, cross-hatched textures creating a rich, dark atmosphere, contrasting with the figure's lighter face and hands.

artworks.title: Anatole France
artworks.medium: etching on laid C & I Honig paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a seated person facing the viewer. The figure is an older man with a beard and bald head, displaying distinct facial features. He is dressed in a collared shirt with visible textures. His arms are positioned forward, with one hand extended in a gesture, fingers spread. The scene includes abstract lines and shading, creating an impression of an interior space, with a background of textured and linear patterns.

artworks.title: Mona
artworks.description: The image is an etching of the upper half of a seated individual. The person is facing forward, with detailed facial features including wrinkles. They wear a headscarf tied under the chin, layered clothing, and their hands are in their lap. The background is plain with a textured surface.

artworks.title: Dagmar
artworks.description: The image shows a seated figure on a rocky surface with one foot dipped in water. The figure has bent limbs and a slightly tilted head. The background consists of overgrown natural surroundings and a body of water. The person has short hair and there are rock formations in the scene.

artworks.title: An Irish Girl or Annie
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a person's body, showcasing their face and shoulders. The person is facing the viewer with a contemplative expression. Their facial features are accentuated by play of light and shadow. They have long, wavy hair falling around their face and shoulders. The individual is wearing a dark garment blending into the background. A hand is positioned near their chest, partially covered by hair. The background features a textured pattern resembling an etched window. No visible jewelry or objects are present.

artworks.title: Storm
artworks.medium: etching on Van Gelder laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse in motion. The image shows a horse depicted in motion, running across a textured landscape. The artwork is composed of intricate linework, creating a sense of movement. The background is filled with diagonal hatchings that add depth. The composition captures the speed and grace of the animal as it charges through the open space. The lines suggest dust being kicked up from the ground and wind in the environment. The tone is monochromatic, emphasizing contrasts between light and shadow.

artworks.title: Girl with a Cigarette II
artworks.description: The image shows a head-and-shoulders view of a person seated slightly to the right of the frame. The individual is in a three-quarter view, holding an ornate vertical object in their left hand, with their gaze directed off to the right beyond the picture's confines. Their facial features are rendered with softened lines, showcasing a strong nose and a subtle smile framed by shadowy hatching, and their hair is voluminous, with loose curls spilling over the shoulders. They are wearing a dark, voluminous cloak or jacket with a thick collar. In their hand, they clutch a tall, narrow scepter or cane with an elaborate design near the top. The background is abstract, with swirling and chaotic lines.

artworks.title: Fisherman at Saint Ives
artworks.medium: etching on Van Gelder laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, a man and a woman, standing close together behind a stone parapet. In the background, there is a townscape with buildings and a river extending into the distance. A large round light or sun is above the horizon. The art style features dense cross-hatching creating texture and depth. The color scheme is sepia. A gas lamp post is on the right, aligned vertically with the woman.

artworks.title: Mrs. Granberg
artworks.description: This image is a sketch of a person showing the upper body from the chest upwards. The subject is facing the viewer slightly angled to the side. They have dark, wavy hair and their facial features are prominently sketched out with shadow accents around the eyes and nose. The clothing consists of a dark, fur-lined garment, and there are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects held by the figure. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Albert Besnard and His Model
artworks.description: The image depicts a man wearing a hat with broad textured lines. He is shown from the shoulders up, with his head turned slightly away to reveal a side profile with a prominent beard. His face and hair are obscured by dense hatch marks. In the background, a woman with long curly hair is sitting, looking slightly to her side. She wears a garment with bunched up sleeves and is seated on or near a draped piece of furniture, possibly a couch. She appears to be holding or resting her forearms near a book or pages on her lap. Behind her, a curtain with vertical lines and indistinct patterns is visible, along with a framed artwork on the wall. The setting suggests an indoor space with walls and a ceiling line. The sketch conveys an intimate, indoor scene in a loose, expressive style.

artworks.title: Ernest Renan
artworks.description: The image depicts a drawing of a man seated from about the waist up. He is slightly turned towards the viewer with a serious expression. The man has distinctive facial features, long, untidy hair, and is dressed in a dark suit and collared shirt. The setting around him shows a shelf with books and papers, as well as a detailed clock. The background consists of various linear patterns and textures, implying a cluttered study or office space.

artworks.title: The Waltz
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dance scene. The image shows intricate line work and cross-hatching to depict a social gathering, capturing movement on a dance floor. Two figures in mid-dance are at the center, with dynamic lines suggesting motion and grace. The background is crowded with other figures, all blending into each other in a swirl of movement and fabric, creating a bustling atmosphere. Lines of varying density create contrast, depicting light and shadow for depth and form.

artworks.title: Auguste Rodin
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with a partial view of his upper body. The man appears to be seated, with his head slightly tilted to one side. His facial features are rugged, with closed eyes, a pronounced nose, and a thick, bushy beard. His hair is medium length and somewhat unkempt. He is wearing a loose-fitting garment. There are sketchy elements and blurred figures around him. The background is shadowed with crosshatching and less defined outlines. The overall composition is monochromatic with an emphasis on lines and shadows.

artworks.title: Bather III (Baigneuse de Dos)
artworks.description: The image shows a close perspective of a rocky terrain beside a body of water. The horizon is placed about a third of the way down from the top of the image, featuring a subtle line where the water meets the distant land or vegetation. The etching technique used includes fine, dense lines and cross-hatching, creating texture and depth through its monochromatic, linear style. The color palette is restricted to shades of gray and black on a tan background. Close to us, there is a detailed etching of the rocky surface and sparse foliage in the foreground leading towards the water beyond.
